mbb_teams: Entities: college/pro basketball teams; Grain: one row per team (columns: market, alias, name, id, code_ncaa, kaggle_team_id, school_ncaa, turner_name); Notable keys/measures: league_name/league_id, conf_name/conf_id, division_name/division_id, venue_id and venue fields (venue_city, venue_state, venue_capacity, venue_name), logo_large/logo_medium/logo_small.
2018_tournament_results: Entities: tournament game results for 2018 season; Grain: one row per team-game in the 2018 tournament (columns: season, round, days_from_epoch, game_date, day, label, seed, market, name, alias, school_ncaa, points); Notable keys/measures: opponent_* fields (opponent_seed, opponent_market, opponent_name, opponent_alias, opponent_school_ncaa, opponent_points) and seed.
mbb_teams_games_sr: Entities: team-level box/summary for a game; Grain: one row per team in a specific game (columns: game_id, season, status, neutral_site, scheduled_date, gametime, conference_game, tournament, tournament_type, tournament_round, tournament_game_no, attendance, lead_changes, times_tied, periods, possession_arrow, venue_id, venue_city, venue_state, venue_address, venue_zip, venue_country, venue_name, venue_capacity, home_team, name, market, team_id, alias); Notable keys/measures: game_id, team_id, home_team flag, attendance, lead_changes, times_tied, logo_large, league_id/conf_id/division_id and their names/aliases.
team_colors: Entities: team color records; Grain: one row per team color value (columns: market, id, code_ncaa, color); Notable keys/measures: market, id, code_ncaa and color hex/name.
adjusted_metrics: Entities: adjusted team metrics by season; Grain: one row per (season, team, stat_name) (columns: season, tm_code, tm, stat_name, raw_stat, raw_rtg, raw_rk, adj_stat, adj_rtg, adj_rk, through_games_of); Notable keys/measures: raw_stat/raw_rtg/raw_rk and adj_stat/adj_rtg/adj_rk, through_games_of.
metric_names: Entities: metric metadata/labels; Grain: one row per statistic name (columns: stat_name, label, concept_name, off_or_def, rank_asc, rd_dec, off_def_stat_name); Notable keys/measures: stat_name and label, off_or_def and ranking flags.
feature_engineering: Entities: engineered team-season features; Grain: one row per team-season (columns: season, team, poss_40min, pace_rating, pace_rank, pts_100poss, efficiency_rating, efficiency_rank); Notable keys/measures: poss_40min, pace_rating/pace_rank, pts_100poss, efficiency_rating/efficiency_rank.
mbb_historical_tournament_games: Entities: historical tournament game outcomes; Grain: one row per tournament game (columns: season, round, days_from_epoch, game_date, day, win_seed, win_region, win_market, win_name, win_alias, win_team_id, win_school_ncaa, win_code_ncaa, win_kaggle_team_id, win_pts, lose_seed, lose_region, lose_market, lose_name, lose_alias, lose_team_id, lose_school_ncaa, lose_code_ncaa, lose_kaggle_team_id, lose_pts, num_ot, academic_year); Notable keys/measures: win_* and lose_* team identifiers and points, num_ot, round, season.
mbb_pbp_sr: Entities: play-by-play game events metadata (summary-level); Grain: one row per play/event or per feed record for a game (columns: game_id, load_timestamp, season, status, scheduled_date, venue_id, venue_name, venue_city, venue_state, venue_address, venue_zip, venue_country, venue_capacity, attendance, neutral_site, conference_game, tournament, tournament_type, round, game_no, away_market, away_name, away_id, away_alias, away_conf_name, away_conf_alias, away_division_name, away_division_alias, away_league_name, home_market, home_name, home_id, home_alias, home_conf_name, home_conf_alias, home_division_name, home_division_alias, home_league_name, period, game_clock); Notable keys/measures: game_id, period, game_clock, load_timestamp, venue and home/away team ids/names.
mascots: Entities: team mascots and related taxonomy; Grain: one row per mascot record (columns: id, market, name, mascot, mascot_name, mascot_common_name, non_tax_type and taxonomic fields tax_subspecies, tax_species, tax_genus, tax_family, tax_order, tax_class, tax_phylum, tax_kingdom, tax_domain); Notable keys/measures: id, market, mascot and taxonomic classifications.
mbb_players_games_sr: Entities: player box/summary for a game; Grain: one row per player in a specific game (columns: game_id, season, neutral_site, scheduled_date, gametime, tournament, tournament_type, tournament_round, tournament_game_no, player_id, last_name, first_name, full_name, abbr_name, status, jersey_number, height, weight, birth_place, birthplace_city, birthplace_state, birthplace_country, class, team_name, team_market, team_id, team_alias, conf_name, conf_alias, division_name, division_alias, league_name, home_team, active, played, starter, minutes, minutes_int64, position, primary_position); Notable keys/measures: game_id, player_id, team_id, minutes/minutes_int64, played/starter flags, physical attributes and birthplace.
mbb_historical_teams_games: Entities: historical team game lines (team-level outcomes); Grain: one row per team-game historically (columns: season, scheduled_date, attendance, market, name, team_code, team_id, alias, current_division, points_game, win, opp_market, opp_name, opp_code, opp_id, opp_alias, opp_current_division, opp_points_game); Notable keys/measures: season, team_id/team_code, points_game, win flag, opponent identifiers and opp_points_game, attendance.
mbb_games_sr: Entity: men's basketball games; Grain: one row per game (game_id) per season; Notable keys/measures: game_id, season, status, coverage, neutral_site, scheduled_date, gametime, conference_game, tournament, tournament_type, tournament_round, tournament_game_no, attendance, lead_changes, times_tied, periods, possession_arrow; venue fields: venue_id, venue_name, venue_city, venue_state, venue_address, venue_zip, venue_country, venue_capacity; home team fields: h_id, h_name, h_market, h_alias, h_logo_large, h_logo_medium; home league/conf/division ids and names: h_league_id, h_league_name, h_league_alias, h_conf_id, h_conf_name, h_conf_alias, h_division_id, h_division_name, h_division_alias
mbb_historical_teams_seasons: Entity: historical team-season records; Grain: one row per team per season (season + team_id/team_code); Notable keys/measures: season, team_id, team_code, market, name, alias, division, current_division, wins, losses, ties
2019_tournament_seeds: Entity: tournament seed assignments for 2019 season; Grain: one row per school per season (school_ncaa + season); Notable keys/measures: season, school_ncaa, seed
